notes.title: Year 2 Anniversary Sale and v1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We shipped out Forgotten Hope to Steam back in 2021 and the last two years has nothing but been amazing. 

To celebrate this milestone, Forgotten Hope is available [b]65%[/b] off from Steam until 15th May. 

In the meantime, we have added full controller support to the game and now you can leave your keyboard and mouse behind and enjoy Forgotten Hope with your favorite controller. 

We poured our hearts and souls in to Forgotten Hope, but we could not come this far without your support. So, thank you everyone who bought our game and leaving us with reviews. Whether good or bad, we value your feedback. And we hope that everyone who played our little game found the courage to move forward and never to give up. ~ Black Hammer Studios 🇱🇰



[b]v1.02 Patch Notes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added full controller support.
[*] Optimized menus for better visibility. 
[*] Additional bug fixes

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40251691/d473cb1bd543f6c8e39f95b7716b5a2cc6f32f0b.png[/img]


[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]When scrolling through the available resolutions drop down menu using a controller, the drop-down menu will visibly glitch however, the correct resolution can be selected and applied without any problems.
[/list]

If you come across any bugs or like to submit feedback to us, you can do so via our dedicated [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/BlackHammerStudios/] subreddit [/url]


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u9L_YKGJlss

notes.content:

notes.title: Buy Forgotten Hope and help a cause.
notes.content:
It's the season of love and we at Black Hammer Studios will be donating 20% of our entire Winter Sale revenue to a suicide prevention and Youth empowerment fund in Sri Lanka. ❤

We are still finalizing some last-minute details and within the next few days, we'll update this announcement with all the necessary information about the fund we are donating to.

Thank you everyone who supported us throughout the last few months, and this is our effort to make some real change in these troubled times. 🙏

Reach us on [url=store.steampowered.com]blackhammer.gamedev@gmail.com[/url] for more details.

notes.title: Forgotten Hope - Halloween Update
notes.content:
Hi, Everyone. 
It's been a while so we decided to add an experimental seasonal update to slightly enhance the game world atmosphere.
Hope everyone is staying safe and sound. 
Enjoy - BlackHammer Studios

notes.title: Forgotten Hope v1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue where the beginning of each memory point shows a frame from the previously triggered memory point. 
    [*]Added a volume slider to adjust/ disable the player's voice.
    [*]Added few missing subtitle boxes for on-screen text. 
    [*]Changed subtitles font for other characters
    [*]Minor environmental changes
[/list]


Submit your bugs and feedback to our dedicated [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/BlackHammerStudios/] subreddit [/url]
